label: copy-phase input 0 being re-fed at middle positions (recall 3-5)
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, and 99% of activation mass is on steps where the fed-back input is the digit 0 (i.e. the model just output an original 0). Concentrated where 0 was at original position 2-4 (recall_idx 3-5) with at least 2 outputs still to go, so mostly in long sequences (L>=7, t 10-13); strongest (max ~4) when 0 was original token 2 in L=9 sequences. Weak or absent when the 0 comes late in the copy (to_go <= 1), in short sequences, or at recall_idx <= 2. Never fires in the original or delimiter phase, and almost never on non-0 inputs (small traces on j/c/a). Rate rises with the number of digits in the sequence but this is not needed. Precision ~0.73: many qualifying 0 steps stay silent, particularly with to_go 2-3.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: 0, j, c, a, w, i; least: t, v, 1, q) and the previous input (most: 0, r, h, i, x, m; least: w, s, v, <DEL>); timing cues that raise it most: recall_idx=3, t=12, L=9 & t=12.
